why: Puts the customize rotate buttons back to the 34px literal they carried before issue #352, which is below the 44 CSS px touch floor Apple/WCAG state and the repo declares as `--hud-control-min`. Nothing else notices: the board still renders, the cluster still fits on one row (it is 40px narrower, not wider), no layout moves that a screenshot diff would catch, and jsdom does no layout so no computed-size assertion anywhere in the suite can see it -- which is exactly why the guard this kills asserts the DECLARATION rather than the rendered box. Measured: KILLED, 1 of 56 in hud.css.test.ts, the 'sized to be hit' case -- re-measured after issue #542 edited that file (the file has grown from the 50 cases this was first counted against; the failing set is still the one case). The token half of that guard is deliberately NOT the target here: lowering `--hud-control-min` itself would also resize `.hud-level-btn` and `.hud-swatch`, so it would be a different and broader defect; this entry isolates the one control the issue was about. Scoped to hud.css.test.ts; expectFailures counts that scoped run only.
